# Excalidraw Data

## Text Elements
Given that it's a first order system (only reactive element is C), the slope is 6 dB/oct by default ^3W5o7EHn

Being a 2nd order filter, the filter action (slope) will
be 12 db/Oct ^cdszp2ju

The exercise is just saying
that Vs is 10% lower than
Vp due to the tap configuration
Thus we have all the variables
except Ns ^YQOnB7uV
